rules.description: Install/prepare lifecycle script invokes shell download-and-execute, encoded PowerShell, inline eval, or network dropper.
Package declares an install/prepare lifecycle script that executes automatically unless --ignore-scripts is enforced.
Invisible, zero-width, bidirectional override, or Unicode Tag characters detected (Trojan Source / hidden prompt injection).
Untrusted package metadata, README, or source contains direct LLM override or jailbreak phrasing.

Sensitive credential file or non-benign process.env data (lexically scoped with parameter shadowing, clean-redeclaration kill, benign env-alias property filtering, optional chaining, and closure capture) flows (directly, multi-hop, via template literals, indirect/.call/.apply invocations, aliased ESM/CJS/createRequire sinks, multi-hop helper wrappers, or bidirectional cross-file/barrel re-export chains) into a network, DNS, or exec sink.
Bulk process.env serialization via JSON.stringify, Object.entries/values/assign, or object spread ({ ...process.env }).

JavaScript source invokes child_process (directly, via aliased ESM/CJS/createRequire imports, indirect (0, fn)/.call/.apply/.bind, Reflect.apply, or multi-hop helper wrappers) with download-and-execute pipes, encoded shell commands, or reverse-shell indicators.

Computed/reversed/concatenated/Unicode-escaped eval/Function/child_process lookup, computed or data:/HTTP(S) dynamic import(), indirect (0, eval/Function)(), .call/.apply/.bind, Function.prototype.constructor, Reflect.get/apply/construct dynamic execution, aliased eval/Function/vm calls, or String.fromCharCode chains.
Base64 or hex-encoded string literal decodes to shell, credential, or C2 execution indicators.
High non-regex Shannon entropy (> 5.85), dense non-regex hex/unicode string or identifier escapes (> 60 escapes and >= 6% density), or _0x hex-identifier obfuscator signature requiring REA recovery.
Compiled WebAssembly, .node native addon, ELF, PE, or Mach-O binary detected; requires REA Tier-2 inspection.
Hardcoded Discord/Slack/Telegram webhook, OAST/collaborator collector, or public raw IPv4 endpoint.
Reference to local credential store (.npmrc, .ssh, .aws, .kube, .git-credentials, .netrc, gcloud ADC).
Package manifest name, version, or bin key contains shell metacharacters or path traversal attempting command injection.
Fetched npm SLSA/in-toto attestation statement subject SHA-512 digest or npm PURL package/version identity diverges from (or omits PURL identity for) the downloaded tarball.
Fetched npm SLSA/in-toto DSSE envelope signature fails cryptographic verification against the bundled verification certificate or key.
